CustomField.description: DWDECI-119. Unchecking this (via the Edit/Deactivate screen flow, not direct edit) soft-deactivates this Service Type and cascades IsActive = false to every child Benefit record (standard field) across all Programs. Past Benefit Assignments and associations remain intact and reportable.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Whether this Service Type can still be pushed to Programs or assigned. Deactivate via the Edit/Deactivate screen flow so child Benefit records across all Programs are updated too.
CustomField.label: Active
